description: Rb₂NaPrCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrCl₆ octahedra. All Rb-Cl bond lengths are 3.90 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PrCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.76 Å. Pr is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form PrCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Pr-Cl bond lengths are 2.75 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Pr atom.
